blurb: A `///` is not a doc comment in Bynk. A doc is written with dashes: `--- text` for one line, or a block between two `---` lines for more. A plain comment is `//`. The fix to `---` is machine-applicable: `bynk check --fix` applies it. A run of four or more slashes is an ordinary comment.
summary: A `///` doc comment first on its line; a Bynk doc is `--- text` or a `---` block (auto-fixable).
